about: Hand-written gold set for license identification. kind=raw: a license string from a manifest/registry; kind=text: an excerpt of a license file or header (abridged and written by the author - NOT the official SPDX texts). expected=null means the input does not say which license applies, so the right answer is to abstain. Labels are the author's reading and have not been reviewed by a lawyer.
